summary: All screens and cursors match, but ordinary corpse creation after a fiery gaze omits the recorder-visible rnz wrapper. js/mon.js:make_corpse builds an RNG environment without rnz; js/obj.js therefore synthesizes its arithmetic from logged component calls. C has 2866 RNG entries and JS has 2865; removing the single C rnz(10)=13 entry makes their entire logs identical. Complete the canonical default RNG family at make_corpse while preserving caller overrides.

source.branch: polyself.c:dogaze AD_FIRE damages an eyed visible monster and kills it. mon.c:xkilled selects a corpse and make_corpse initializes it through mkcorpstat. No caller-supplied RNG environment is present on this ordinary killed route; the default make_corpse environment lacks rnz.
callers: polyself.c:dogaze 1715-1729 draws d(2,6), tests the inventory-destruction rn2(20) gate, applies damage and calls killed on death. js/polyself.js:dogaze 2566-2590 awaits killed(mtmp,state) with no injected death environment.

mon.c:killed 3470-3473 calls xkilled(XKILL_GIVEMSG); xkilled 3618-3625 calls make_corpse after corpse_chance, and uses the resulting cadaver for its buried-corpse condition. js/mon.js:killed/xkilled forward the ordinary environment and xkilled 5997-6002 awaits make_corpse.

mon.c:mondied 3251-3263 is make_corpse's other C caller; js/mon.js:mondied 5595-5604 forwards its caller environment. The shared make_corpse default correction applies to both families without rewriting their call sites.
dependencies: mkobj.c:mkcorpstat 2067-2118 calls mksobj/mksobj_at with CORPSTAT_INIT. mksobj 1204-1228 calls set_corpsenm, which calls start_corpse_timeout 1389-1431. That helper consumes rnd.c:rnz 214-229 before Rider/troll/zombie overrides. Existing JS owners are corpstat.js, obj.js and timeout.js; they already compute the same result and need no source expansion for this fix.

js/obj.js:sourceRandom 592-618 uses injected rnz when supplied; otherwise it derives the same integer result from rn2(1000), rne(4), rn2(2), and omits the rnz wrapper log. js/rng.js:rnz 185-187 delegates to rnzFrom, whose final logResult records this wrapper after the same internal calls. Fix the missing canonical default at the caller rather than invent a log entry in the timeout owner.

Preserve env.random overrides, including clone-specific rnz from createCoreRandom in rng.js:119-129. The planning dispatcher in unported_monster_actions.js obtains that complete family. A focused test must prove explicit rnz remains authoritative and planning calls do not consume live game.coreCtx.

All required source functions have existing implementations; this is a bounded RNG environment divergence fix. No whole mon.c:make_corpse/xkilled, polyself.c:dogaze or mkobj.c:start_corpse_timeout completion credit is requested. No diagnostic command dispatcher or B162 memory-size helper changes are needed.

The first mismatch is segment0 step103 at index2849: C rnz(10)=13 @ start_corpse_timeout(mkobj.c:1413), JS rn2(12)=5. The matching screen count is zero remaining screens, not a passing session.

Focused selected-case scan at bd5b1d85694dec713333c7ca5c26df1eebf9fec8 reproduced the same mismatch with no refusal: bounded run-ATwgR2, .cache/B163/focused-scan.log. All115 screens were emitted. The source RNG call annotation locates the downstream timer but does not identify which caller lost its canonical RNG operation.

Read-only runtime comparison .cache/B163/rng-tail.mjs replayed the unchanged admitted recording in a fresh process and saved runtime-rng.json. It measured C2866 and JS2865 RNG entries; the logs become equal over their entire lengths after deleting only C index2849 rnz(10)=13. The preceding calls rn2(1000)=333, rn2(4)=1, rne(4)=1, rn2(2)=1 and every subsequent call agree. This rules out a missing entropy draw or a different integer timer value as the first cause.

The frozen runner fresh-process confirmation uses node frozen/ps_test_runner.mjs --worker-session=challenges/cases/v30/v30-pyrolisk-gaze.session.json; .cache/B163/frozen-confirmation.log preserves its RNG-only failure. No C game was recorded or altered during investigation.

Read whole upstream mon.c:make_corpse 564-940, polyself.c:dogaze 1642-1774, mkobj.c:mkcorpstat 2067-2118 and start_corpse_timeout 1389-1431, and rnd.c:rnz 214-229 at revision16ff59115315917b93185d026aeefea06db9b0f4. The default make_corpse JS family at mon.js5353 contains d,rn1,rn2,rnd,rne,rnl and merges env.random after those defaults, but omits rnz. mon.js RNG import at670 also omits rnz.

Counter-evidence: dogaze's inventory destruction/ignition environments also omit rnz, but its death call is killed(mtmp,state) with no such environment. The selected missing timer wrapper arises in make_corpse's own default object-generation family; adding rnz only to dogaze's inventory arms would not repair this trace.
